title: PARK: Accurate Block Retrieval for Sparse Attention in Video Diffusion Transformers
title_zh: PARK：用于视频扩散Transformer稀疏注意力的精确块检索

paragraphs.en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have become a dominant architecture for video generation, but their efficiency is limited by the quadratic complexity of full attention. Sparse attention reduces this cost by retrieving important blocks and computing attention only within them, but inaccurate retrieval can either degrade generation quality or yield unnecessary computation. We identify two retrieval mismatches in methods that retrieve blocks using the averaged representations of query and key blocks: (i) query-side aggregation mismatch, where averaging queries before Softmax fails to preserve their individual attention preferences, and (ii) key-side clustering metric mismatch, where standard Euclidean clustering in the original key space can group keys with dissimilar QK scores under the current query, so their average representation may not accurately represent how the current query scores individual keys. These mismatches can lead to inaccurate block retrieval. To address these mismatches, we propose PARK, a training-free sparse attention method for accurate block retrieval. PARK retains every original query, independently normalizes its attention over key blocks, and then averages these distributions within each query block. It also uses information from the current queries to transform keys before clustering, so that keys receiving similar QK scores are grouped together. A fused GPU kernel further reduces the overhead of block retrieval. Experiments on HunyuanVideo and Wan demonstrate that PARK improves block retrieval accuracy and preserves generation quality while accelerating inference, achieving the best quality-efficiency trade-off among the compared sparse attention methods.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散变换器（DiTs）已成为视频生成领域的主流架构，但其效率受到全注意力机制二次复杂度的限制。 稀疏注意力通过检索重要块并仅在这些块内部计算注意力来降低这一成本，但检索不准确可能会降低生成质量或导致不必要的计算。 我们识别出两种基于查询块和键块平均表示进行检索的方法中的匹配问题：（i）查询侧聚合不匹配，即在 Softmax 前对查询进行平均会使其无法保留各自的注意力偏好；以及（ii）键侧聚类度量不匹配，即原始键空间中的标准欧氏聚类可能会将当前查询下 QK 分数差异较大的键归为一组，因此它们的平均表示可能无法准确反映当前查询对各键的评分情况。 这些不匹配可能导致不准确的块检索。 为解决这些问题，我们提出了 PARK——一种无需训练的稀疏注意力方法，可实现精确的块检索。 PARK 保留所有原始查询，独立地对其在键块上的注意力进行归一化，然后在每个查询块内对这些分布求平均。 该方法还利用当前查询的信息在聚类前对键进行变换，从而将具有相似 QK 分数的键分组在一起。 融合后的 GPU 内核进一步降低了块检索的额外开销。 在 HunyuanVideo 和 Wan 上的实验表明，PARK 提高了块检索的准确性并保持了生成质量，同时加速了推理过程，在比较的稀疏注意力方法中实现了最佳的质量与效率平衡。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) ( Peebles and Xie (2023) ) have emerged as a dominant paradigm for modern video generation, demonstrating strong scalability and enabling high-fidelity, temporally coherent synthesis ( Yang et al. (2025b) ; Kong et al. (2024) ; Wan et al. (2025) ). However, generating high-resolution and long videos involves a large number of spatio-temporal tokens. Since 3D full attention scales quadratically with token count, it becomes a major computational bottleneck in video generation ( Xi et al. (2025) ; Zhang et al. (2025b) ; Vaswani et al. (2017) ).

paragraphs.en: Fortunately, attention maps in video DiTs are inherently sparse, with only a small fraction of token interactions contributing significantly to the output ( Sun et al. (2026) ; Zhang et al. (2026) ). Sparse attention exploits this property by computing attention only over these critical token interactions, substantially reducing computation with little degradation in generation quality. In practice, query and key tokens are partitioned into blocks by grouping consecutive tokens, and attention is computed only for a selected subset of blocks. These blocks are retrieved by estimating their importance and selecting those with the highest scores ( Guo et al. (2024) ; Li et al. (2025c) ). This process, referred to as block retrieval, produces a sparse mask that specifies which blocks are computed.
paragraphs.zh: 幸运的是，视频 DiT 中的注意力映射本质上具有稀疏性，只有少数令牌交互对输出有显著贡献（Sun 等人（2026）；Zhang 等人（2026））。 稀疏注意力通过仅在这些关键令牌交互上计算注意力来利用这一特性，从而大幅减少计算量，同时几乎不降低生成质量。 在实践中，查询和键令牌通过将连续令牌分组划分为多个块，并且仅对选定的子集块计算注意力。 这些块通过估计其重要性并选择得分最高的块来获取（Guo 等人（2024）；Li 等人（2025c））。 这一过程被称为块检索，它生成一个稀疏掩码，用于指定需要计算的块。

paragraphs.en: Existing training-free sparse attention methods broadly fall into static and dynamic methods. Static methods ( Li et al. (2025a) ; Xi et al. (2025) ; Li et al. (2025b) ; Zhang et al. (2025c) ) derive sparse masks from offline attention profiling or predefined rules and apply them to individual layers or attention heads during inference. Dynamic methods ( Xia et al. (2025) ; Zhang et al. (2025a) ; Xu et al. (2025) ) perform block retrieval at runtime using lightweight block importance estimation, adapting the sparse masks to the current attention pattern. Additionally, recent token-reordering methods ( Yang et al. (2025a) ; Zhao et al. (2025) ; Tan et al. (2026a) ; Luo et al. (2026) ) cluster semantically similar tokens and permute them into contiguous blocks. This helps retain more critical interactions with fewer blocks, improving the efficiency-quality trade-off.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的无需训练的稀疏注意力方法大致可分为静态方法和动态方法。 静态方法（Li et al. (2025a)；Xi et al. (2025)；Li et al. (2025b)；Zhang et al. (2025c)）通过离线注意力分析或预定义规则生成稀疏掩码，并在推理时将其应用于单个层或注意力头。 动态方法（Xia et al. (2025)；Zhang et al. (2025a)；Xu et al. (2025)）在运行时通过轻量级的块重要性估计执行块检索，从而将稀疏掩码适配到当前的注意力模式。 此外，近期的令牌重排序方法（Yang et al. (2025a)；Zhao et al. (2025)；Tan et al. (2026a)；Luo et al. paragraphs.en: Even with token reordering, the effectiveness of sparse attention depends on how accurately it retrieves important blocks. Missing important blocks can degrade generation quality, while selecting unimportant blocks wastes computation. To compensate for inaccurate retrieval, more blocks may need to be retained to preserve generation quality, limiting the achievable speedup. Accurate block retrieval is therefore essential to improving the efficiency-quality trade-off of sparse attention.
paragraphs.zh: 即使对 token 进行了重排序，稀疏注意力机制的有效性仍取决于其能否准确检索到重要块。 遗漏重要块会降低生成质量，而选择非重要块则会浪费计算资源。 为了弥补检索的不准确性，可能需要保留更多块以维持生成质量，这会限制所能达到的加速效果。 因此，准确检索块对于改善稀疏注意力机制的效率与质量之间的权衡至关重要。

paragraphs.en: To keep block retrieval efficient, many existing methods estimate block importance from the average-pooled representations (or centroids ) of query and key blocks, Our theoretical analysis of the resulting estimation errors reveals two retrieval mismatches in this common centroid-based design:
paragraphs.zh: 为保持块检索的高效性，许多现有方法通过查询块和键块的平均池化表示（或质心）来估计块的重要性。我们对由此产生的估计误差进行的理论分析揭示了这种常见的基于质心的设计中存在两种检索不匹配问题：

paragraphs.en: M1: Query-side aggregation mismatch. Each query independently yields an attention distribution over all key blocks, and these query-specific preferences jointly determine which blocks should be selected for the sparse mask. As analyzed in Sec. 4.1 , averaging the original queries into a single query centroid before Softmax normalization ignores these individual preferences and can misestimate the attention assigned to each key block, leading to an inaccurate sparse mask. Figure 1 (c) shows that retaining the original queries instead of using query centroids reduces attention-weight approximation error by 47.7–49.0%.
paragraphs.zh: M1：查询端聚合不匹配。 每个查询都会独立生成一个覆盖所有键块的注意力分布，而这些与查询相关的偏好共同决定了哪些块应被选中用于稀疏掩码。 如第 4.1 节所分析，在 Softmax 归一化之前将原始查询平均为一个单一的查询中心点，会忽略这些个体偏好，并可能导致对每个键块所分配注意力的误判，从而产生不准确的稀疏掩码。 图 1(c) 显示，保留原始查询而非使用查询中心点，可将注意力权重近似误差降低 47.7%–49.0%。

paragraphs.en: M2: Key-side clustering metric mismatch. Existing reordering methods cluster key tokens using standard Euclidean clustering in the original key space and use the key block centroids for importance estimation. As analyzed in Sec. 4.2 , centroid-based estimation is more accurate when keys in the same block receive similar dot-product scores from the current query. However, this clustering metric compares only the keys themselves and does not account for how the current query scores them. Consequently, standard Euclidean clustering may group keys that are scored differently by the current query, making key centroids less accurate for block importance estimation. Figure 1 (c) shows that clustering keys by QK-score similarity reduces centered log-mass error by 16.9–17.2% compared with standard Euclidean clustering.
paragraphs.zh: M2：键侧聚类指标不匹配。 现有的重排序方法在原始键空间中采用标准欧氏聚类对键令牌进行聚类，并利用键块的质心进行重要性估计。 如第 4.2 节所分析，当同一块中的键从当前查询获得相似的点积分数时，基于质心的估计更为准确。 然而，这种聚类指标仅比较键本身，而未考虑当前查询对它们的评分方式。 因此，标准欧氏聚类可能会将当前查询评分不同的键归为一组，导致键质心在块重要性估计上的准确性下降。 图 1(c) 显示，通过 QK 分数相似性对键进行聚类，与标准欧氏聚类相比，可将中心化对数质量误差降低 16.9%–17.2%。

paragraphs.en: To address these mismatches, we propose PARK , a training-free sparse attention method for accurate block retrieval via P er-query A ttention-Mass Aggregation (PAMA) and Query- R esponse K ey Clustering (QRKC). First, PAMA retains original queries, computes a separate Softmax distribution over the key blocks for each query, and aggregates these distributions by averaging them within each query block to estimate block importance for sparse mask selection. This preserves query-specific attention preferences and eliminates the aggregation mismatch introduced by query centroids. We fuse per-query normalization and averaging into a custom kernel for efficient execution. Second, QRKC uses a linear transformation derived from the current queries to map the keys into a query-conditioned space for clustering, where Euclidean distance reflects how similarly those queries score them. paragraphs.en: Centroid-based block retrieval compresses both query and key blocks before estimating their importance. Although this design is efficient, the two compressions introduce fundamentally different approximations. We analyze them relative to the exact block importance in Eq. paragraphs.en: Averaging queries into a centroid before Softmax can lead to inaccurate block-importance estimates. To analyze this error, we retain all original keys. paragraphs.en: In this section, we introduce PARK, a training-free sparse attention framework designed for accurate block retrieval via Per-Query Attention-Mass Aggregation (PAMA) and Query-Response Key Clustering (QRKC). PAMA preserves all original queries, computes their normalized attention over key blocks separately, and then averages these attention weights within each query block for block-importance estimation (§ 5.1 ). QRKC uses information from the current queries to transform the keys before clustering, so that keys receiving similar QK scores are grouped together (§ 5.2 ). These two modules improve block retrieval on both the query and key sides. An overview of our proposed PARK framework is shown in Figure 2 .

paragraphs.en: SVG2 ( Yang et al. (2025a) ) independently clusters queries and keys using Euclidean K-means, while SVOO ( Luo et al. (2026) ) couples the two partitions through iterative bidirectional co-clustering. Both methods then estimate block importance using query and key centroids. In contrast, PAMA retains every original query, normalizes its attention over key blocks separately, and then averages these weights within each query block to estimate block importance. QRKC derives a query-dependent metric from all current queries and transforms the keys before clustering, so that Euclidean K-means minimizes the average squared QK-score error introduced by key centroids. PARK therefore adopts an asymmetric retrieval design that preserves query-specific preferences while clustering keys using a theoretically derived metric.
paragraphs.zh: SVG2（Yang 等人，2025a）使用欧氏 K-means 算法独立地对查询和键进行聚类，而 SVOO（Luo 等人，2026）则通过迭代的双向联合聚类将这两个分区耦合在一起。随后，这两种方法都利用查询和键的中心点来估计分块重要性。相比之下，PAMA 保留了每个原始查询，分别对查询在键块上的注意力进行归一化，然后在每个查询块内对这些权重取平均值以估计分块重要性。QRKC 从所有当前查询中推导出一个依赖于查询的度量，并在聚类前对键进行变换，使得欧氏 K-means 算法能够最小化由键中心点引入的平均 QK 分数平方误差。因此，PARK 采用了一种非对称的检索设计，在利用理论推导出的度量对键进行聚类的同时，保留了查询特定的偏好。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we proposed PARK, a training-free sparse attention method designed for fast diffusion-based video generation. We identified query-side aggregation mismatch and key-side clustering metric mismatch in centroid-based block retrieval. To address them, PAMA preserves query-specific attention preferences, while QRKC clusters keys using a query-dependent metric. Experiments across four models show that PARK preserves high generation quality while achieving 1.53 × 1.53\times – 1.76 × 1.76\times end-to-end speedups over dense attention.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 PARK，一种无需训练的稀疏注意力方法，专为基于扩散模型的快速视频生成而设计。 我们在基于中心点的块检索中发现了查询侧聚合不匹配和键侧聚类度量不匹配的问题。 为了解决这些问题，PAMA 保留了查询特定的注意力偏好，而 QRKC 则使用依赖查询的度量来对键进行聚类。 在四个模型上的实验表明，PARK 在保持高生成质量的同时，相比密集注意力方法实现了 1.53 × 1.53\times – 1.76 × 1.76\times 的端到端加速。

paragraphs.en: The first pass computes row-wise LogSumExp through online updates over key-centroid tiles. The second recomputes the logits, normalizes each tile, and accumulates block importance. This approximately doubles QK-centroid GEMM work but keeps register usage independent of N K N_{K} for fixed tile sizes. Logits, probabilities, and LogSumExp values remain on chip rather than in HBM, allowing larger N K N_{K} than Full- K K .
paragraphs.zh: 第一遍通过关键中心点瓦片的在线更新计算行方向的 LogSumExp。 第二遍重新计算 logits，对每个瓦片进行归一化，并累积块重要性。 这大约使 QK-中心点 GEMM 的工作量翻倍，但在固定瓦片尺寸下，寄存器使用量与 N K N_{K} 无关。 Logits、概率和 LogSumExp 值保留在芯片上而非 HBM 中，这使得 N K N_{K} 可以比 Full- K K 更大。

paragraphs.en: This work focuses on accelerating video generation with diffusion models. Our evaluation is limited to this setting and does not establish the applicability of PARK to text-based large language models or other multimodal tasks. These settings may exhibit different attention patterns and inference workflows, which may require adaptations to PARK. Further research is needed to determine whether PARK can provide similar efficiency benefits in these settings while preserving output quality.
paragraphs.zh: 这项工作专注于利用扩散模型加速视频生成。 我们的评估仅限于此设定，并未证明 PARK 适用于基于文本的大型语言模型或其他多模态任务。 这些设定可能表现出不同的注意力模式和推理流程，因此可能需要对 PARK 进行调整。 需要进一步研究，以确定 PARK 是否能在这些设定中提供类似的效率提升，同时保持输出质量。
